赵老驴和杏花村的女人们最新章节_第9章 有点上头第1页_赵老驴和杏花村的女人们风过林海_热点小说网
> 第9章 有点上头（第1页）
不行了不行了，再想下去今晚就别想睡觉了！
毕竟还有一万块钱的网贷要还哩，还不上的话就要变老赖了。
他这个老光棍，已经被村里人笑话了几十年，他实在不想继续被人耻笑，跟个小丑一样过完这一辈子！
但说到赚钱，赵大柱现在一点头绪都没有。
虽然获得了传承，得到了修炼功法，可是他还没有迈过那道门槛。
传承当中记载的那么多医术，以他目前的实力，大部分都无法掌握。
这样一来，想通过传承中的医术赚钱，恐怕不是那么容易的。
难道继续干老本行，扛着锄头种地？
思考到这里，赵大柱就给了自己一巴掌。
自己本来就是老农民，种地有什么丢人的？
再说了，好不容易才从王建国那个狗东西的手里要回自己的两亩地，不种地的话，那两亩地岂不是要荒废了？
赵大柱深打定主意以后，躁动不安的心便逐渐安定下来。
第二天，王彩霞推开赵大柱家院门，先是探头探脑的看了看，然后才终于走了进来。
她是来取托盘和碗筷的，看到有很多床单没有清洗。
王彩霞便坐在小板凳上，两只手抓着床单使劲的搓洗，胳膊上的衣服袖子高高卷起，时不时还抬起湿漉漉的手擦一把汗。
赵大柱从屋子里出来，看着王彩霞给自己洗床单被套的样子，竟有些感动。
毕竟王彩霞不是他婆娘，按理来说是没必要帮他做这种家务活的。
“要不还是我自己来吧？”赵大柱走过去说道。

“还是我来吧，洗衣服不是你们大老爷们的活儿。”王彩霞摇摇头说道。
“可……可你这样，我脸皮子都挂不住了。”赵大柱搓着手说道。
王彩霞嗤笑一声，说道：“你都糟老头了，怎么还跟个大男孩一样动不动就不好意思？难道没结过婚的男人都像你这样？”
赵大柱感到脸皮子发烫，但还是说道：“网上不是有句话么，男人至死是少年。”
王彩霞摆摆手，便催促道：“你刚才不是说你要去县城买种子么，那你快去，等你回来，床单被套就都洗好了。”
赵大柱只是略微犹豫就点头离开，毕竟他在这儿确实帮不上什么忙，而且也能避免尴尬。
而赵大柱刚走，王彩霞就伸出一只手，将还没洗的被套拿了起来。
看着脏乎乎的被套，王彩霞脸上的表情一下子变得十分奇怪。
“居然这么多……赵老头光棍一辈子，到底攒了多少存货……”
驶向县城的公交车给人一种老态龙钟的感觉，不仅慢悠悠的，而且还摇摇晃晃。
现在正是六月份，本就天气炎热，公交车里还这么多人，自然就更闷热了。
最要命的是车里还没有空调，就连从窗户吹进来的风也是热的。
车上的乘客不停的擦汗，赵大柱也是，他都汗流浃背了。
忽然，公交车剧烈摇晃，赵大柱一个没站稳就扑到了前面那个十八九岁少女的身上。
这个少女一头黄毛，胳膊上还有纹身，明显是混社会的精神小妹。
她先是一瞪眼，然后就一个大嘴巴子抽了过来，抽在赵大柱的脸上发出啪的一声脆响。
“你个老流氓居然敢占我便宜，你也不撒泡尿照照你那样儿，都能当我爷爷了，竟然还动手动脚……”
这个精神小妹十分泼辣的怒骂起来，车厢里的乘客于是全都朝赵大柱看去。
赵大柱火冒三丈，抓着扶手站好便呵斥道：“你个女娃子怎么说话哩，嘴上积点德行不？再说了我哪里占你便宜了？”

The latest chapter of Zhao Laolu and the women of Xinghua Village_Chapter 9 A little bit above Page 1_Zhao Laolu and the women of Xinghua Village wind through the forest_Hot Novel Network
>Chapter 9 A little superior (Page 1)
No, no, no, if I think about it any more, I won’t be able to sleep tonight!
After all, I still have an online loan of 10,000 yuan to repay, and if I don't pay it back, I will become a deadbeat.
He, an old bachelor, has been laughed at by the villagers for decades. He really doesn't want to continue to be laughed at and spend his whole life like a clown!
But when it comes to making money, Zhao Dazhu has no clue now.
Although he had obtained the inheritance and practiced the techniques, he had not yet crossed that threshold.
There are so many medical skills recorded in the inheritance, but with his current strength, most of them cannot be mastered.
In this way, it may not be that easy to make money through the inherited medical skills.
Do you want to continue doing your job, farming with a hoe?
After thinking about this, Zhao Dazhu slapped himself.
I am an old farmer myself, what’s the shame in farming?
Besides, I finally got my two acres of land back from that bitch Wang Jianguo. If I didn't cultivate the land, wouldn't those two acres of land be abandoned?
After Zhao Dazhu made up his mind, his restless heart gradually calmed down.
The next day, Wang Caixia opened the door of Zhao Dazhu's house, first looked around, and then finally walked in.
She came to get the trays and dishes, and saw that there were many sheets that had not been washed.
Wang Caixia sat on the small bench, grabbing the sheets with both hands and scrubbing them vigorously. The sleeves of the clothes on her arms were rolled up high, and from time to time she would raise her wet hands to wipe the sweat.
Zhao Dazhu came out of the house and was a little moved when he saw Wang Caixia washing his sheets and quilt.
After all, Wang Caixia is not his mother-in-law, so there is no need to help him with such housework.
"How about I do it myself?" Zhao Dazhu walked over and said.
"Let me do it. Washing clothes is not your job." Wang Caixia shook her head and said.
"But...but if you do this, I can't even bear my shame." Zhao Dazhu said while rubbing his hands.
Wang Caixia sneered and said: "You are such a bad old man, why are you still embarrassed like a big boy? Are all unmarried men like you?"
Zhao Dazhu felt his face getting hot, but he still said: "Isn't there a saying on the Internet that a man will remain a boy until he dies?"
Wang Caixia waved her hand and urged: "Didn't you just say that you were going to the county town to buy seeds? Then go quickly. When you come back, the sheets and quilt covers will be washed."
Zhao Dazhu just hesitated slightly before nodding and leaving. After all, he really couldn't help much here, and he could also avoid embarrassment.
As soon as Zhao Dazhu left, Wang Caixia stretched out a hand and picked up the unwashed quilt cover.
Looking at the dirty quilt cover, the expression on Wang Caixia's face suddenly became very strange.
"There are so many...How much inventory has Old Man Zhao accumulated in his whole life of being a bachelor..."
The bus heading to the county town gave people an old-fashioned feeling. It was not only slow but also rickety.
It's June now, and the weather is already hot. With so many people in the bus, it's naturally even hotter.
The most terrible thing is that there is no air conditioning in the car, and even the wind blowing in from the window is hot.
The passengers in the car kept wiping their sweat, including Zhao Dazhu, who was sweating profusely.
Suddenly, the bus shook violently, and Zhao Dazhu fell on the eighteen-year-old girl in front of him before he could stand still.
This girl has yellow hair and tattoos on her arms. She is obviously a spirited girl from mixed society.
She glared at first, and then slapped Zhao Dazhu's face with a big mouth, making a crisp sound.
"How dare you, an old gangster, take advantage of me? Why don't you just urinate and do what you do?"Now that I am a grandfather, I still do something..."
This spirited girl cursed very fiercely, and all the passengers in the carriage looked at Zhao Dazhu.
Zhao Dazhu was so angry that he grabbed the handrail and stood up and scolded: "You are such a girl, why are you talking? Do you have some virtue in your mouth? Besides, how can I take advantage of you? "
